== Infobox ==

* Event type: Disaster
* Location: Land of the Mangaboos

== Biography ==

The Rain of Stones is a disaster that struck the city of the Mangaboos, cracking and breaking houses. A man of authority accuses Zeb of having caused it, and later holds Dorothy and her companions responsible for the damage unless they can prove their innocence.
